subject.title: feat(feishu): pass through form_value, input_value, option(s) from card actions

question: What agent-visible Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw expose when callbacks include `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, `options`, or `name` alongside existing `value.text` or `value.command`?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but the JSON-vs-command text shape affects existing channel behavior and should be decided by the Feishu/plugin owner before merge.

options.title: Refresh around parser plus command compatibility
options.body: Update the PR for current main so the parser preserves the new fields and the handler keeps slash-command dispatch stable while exposing form/select data in a documented shape.

options.title: Ship only a narrow form passthrough
options.body: Limit the immediate fix to `form_value` or another minimal field subset if maintainers want a smaller compatibility surface before deciding selectors and input fields.

options.title: Close in favor of the canonical issue
options.body: Pause this conflicted branch and leave https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43202 open for a fresh implementation with live proof.

recommendation.title: Refresh around parser plus command compatibility
recommendation.body: Update the PR for current main so the parser preserves the new fields and the handler keeps slash-command dispatch stable while exposing form/select data in a documented shape.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin contact for this channel contract.
